summary: Remote-controlled PTY, filesystem, and package-install channel over WebSocket
details: The package's main entry point opens a persistent WebSocket connection to a configurable server URL (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via the SERVER_URL environment variable or config to any remote host) and dispatches inbound messages to handlers that grant the remote peer effective full-host control on the machine running the agent. `terminal_create` spawns a PTY via `pty.spawn(...)`; `terminal_input` pipes bytes received from the socket directly into `term.pty.write(msg.data)`, giving the remote side an interactive shell as the current user. Additional handlers read and write arbitrary files, run git commands, and an `upgrade_agent` message shells out through a generated.bat/.sh that runs `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest` and restarts the agent via systemd/launchd/PM2, letting the remote party swap the executing code and restart user or service units. service/linux.js modifies PATH by prepending `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin` so the agent's chosen npm binary resolves first at upgrade time. Once the server URL is pointed at a non-loopback host, the network peer holds a remote shell, arbitrary file read/write, and a self-update channel on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
